_note: instance_id is intentionally empty by default: the test script validates any configured ID against ListInstances and falls back to auto-discovering the first ACTIVE instance in the region; if none exists, instance-scoped cases (TC-07..TC-13) are SKIPPED instead of failing. Set RDS_INSTANCE_ID or edit this field to pin a specific instance.

test_cases.name: List RDS Instances (inventory & status)
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with instance list (name, id, status, datastore, volume)

test_cases.name: Compact Instance Status Table
test_cases.command: hcloud RDS ListInstances --cli-region={region} --cli-output=json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(i.get('name'), i.get('id'), i.get('status'), (i.get('datastore') or {}).get('type'), (i.get('volume') or {}).get('size')) for i in d.get('instances',[])]"
test_cases.expected: One line per instance with name/id/status/engine/volume

test_cases.name: Instance Detail (ListInstances --id)
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with instance detail (status, datastore, volume, nodes)

test_cases.name: Slow Logs (last 24h)
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with slow_log_list (empty list is valid)

test_cases.name: Error Logs (last 24h)
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 with error_log_list (empty list is valid)
